race.description: Team Aidan Markets This Sunday Mdn Plate
race.comment: CREDIBILITY (1) is deep into his maiden prep but continues to race well. Came from near the tail on the bend to finish just 1.5 lengths from the winner last start over this distance at the Gold Coast. Draws a better gate this time and brings the right form to this average maiden. TORPEDO TUBE (6) went to the front in a change of tactics last start and responded by hanging on gamely for second over 1250m at Kempsey. Query at 1400m but should be prominent for a long way. LOGAN DOWNS (3) has led for home but tired in the dying stages of his two races this prep, both over 1200m. Could be tough to reel in with a bit less pressure up front today. QUI ROUGE (12) has minor claims following a distant third over this trip at Ballina recently. LE STARCELL (4) was safely held first-up but strips fitter and is better placed out to this trip.
